scope: Customer sell flow is now fully server-driven and admin-configurable: active entries/build roles/PARTS children come from /api/v1/sell-taxonomy, and categories can be added (with runtime build roles) and removed at runtime

businessFlow.subject: Customer /sell renders from server taxonomy and reflects runtime-created sell entries

notes: Verified headed against the local dev stack (web :3000, api :4000). Public GET /api/v1/sell-taxonomy returns only is_active entries and /sell renders that exact set (is_active=false hid Laptop/Laptop Parts; flipping them true surfaced them immediately). Laptop build roles (Laptop RAM*/Laptop Storage*/Battery/Keyboard/Charger/Screen) and Laptop Parts child categories render from API components/children. A runtime entry was created through POST /api/v1/admin/sell-entry-config (category 'Monitor' -> entryKey 'MONITOR') and immediately appeared as a 'Monitor' card on /sell. The full runtime lifecycle (create entry -> create build component with a runtime role 'strap' -> public taxonomy reflects it -> delete component -> delete entry) was verified against the live API (curl 201/200) because the Playwright MCP browser does not dispatch React events reliably against the admin Next dev app; the customer-facing surface was verified headed.
